badge: New. Written by an AI agent
headline: Find out how businesses like yours failed, before you build yours.
subhead: Describe your idea. Retrospecty researches real companies that failed doing something similar and compares your idea against them. Every case is named and linked to a public source you can check.
form_note: Two or three sentences is enough: who it is for, what you sell, how you make money. The report is written by an AI agent from live research. There are no calls or meetings.
sample_intro: This sample uses an invented idea, not a real customer. Retrospecty is new, so this shows the format, not a track record.

features.title: Real, named failures
features.body: Each comparison is a company that actually failed, with a source link you can open and read yourself.

features.title: Your idea against theirs
features.body: The report shows where your plan resembles theirs, and the traps they fell into.

features.title: Automated and plain
features.body: An AI agent does the research and writing. No calls, no consultants, no jargon.
